Frequently Asked Questions (Etsy Offsite Ads)

Should I raise my Etsy prices by the full 12% to cover Offsite Ads?

Usually no—if only 15%–20% of your orders come from Offsite Ads, raising every listing by just 2.5%–3.5% mathematically absorbs the blended cost without hurting your organic conversion rate.

Can a repeat customer trigger Etsy Offsite Ads again?

Yes! Any click on an Etsy Offsite Ad within 30 days attaches the 12%/15% fee to ALL orders that buyer places from your shop in that window—which is why moving repeat customers to Shopify protects your margins.
